sentences.text:
(Victim X Minor Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh An
 Dated : 12-11-2024
Shri Neelesh Agrawal - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Anirudha Malpani - G.A./P.L. for respondents/State

This writ petition has been filed for medical termination of pregnancy of the petitioner/prosecutrix,
a minor, who is a rape victim, and has lodged an FIR at Crime No.434/2024 at Police Station Dwarkapuri under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5I, 5J(ii), 6 of POCSO Act.
Counsel has submitted that the petitioner/prosecutrix is carrying 20 weeks and 6 days of pregnancy and wants it to be terminated.
On due consideration of submissions and perusal of the record, prayer appears to be reasonable.

In such circumstances, the petitioner/prosecutrix is directed to appear before the Head of Department, Gynecology Department, M.Y. Hospital, Indore on 13.11.2024 at 10:30 AM for her examination, if her pregnancy can be terminated.
Let the report of the same be also sent immediately to this Court within a day's time.
Counsel for the State is directed to convey to the aforesaid authority regarding the order passed today by this Court.
Let the matter be listed on 14.11.2024.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) 2 WP-35378-2024 JUDGE Pankaj Victim X Minor vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68220467/
